scenario: 社区搜索 (UGC 短文本搜索): 用户在社区平台搜索帖子、问答、评论等 UGC 内容。 核心指标是搜索相关性 (nDCG) 和点击率 (CTR)。 关注：语义匹配、query 理解、短文本召回、排序模型、LLM 在搜索中的应用。

papers.title: Component-Aware Feedback for Self-Evolving Programs
papers.authors: Ethan Lin, Jinming Nian, Yi Fang
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.38639v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: LLM-guided evolutionary search can discover complex programs, but existing methods mostly only save candidate programs and fitness scores while discarding which component edits produced which fitness metric changes. Existing methods force the mutator LLM to infer the effect of prior edits from cluttered histories, making program search slow and unstable. This is especially true for locally servable LLMs to evolve multi-component systems. We introduce component-aware feedback, which compares each evaluated program with its parent, identifies the components that changed, and logs them with the associated metric differences into an attribution memory that later mutations read. The memory keeps each change in two reference frames, local against the parent it came from and global against the seed program, which shows both the immediate effect of a change and the cumulative progress made since the seed. We study this on LLM reranking, a mult
papers.summary: 该研究针对自演化程序只记录总分、难以定位有效修改的问题，比较子程序与父程序的组件变化，并保存局部及相对初始程序的指标差值。在 12 个 BRIGHT 数据集上，用中位数约三分之一搜索预算达到最强基线最终质量，最终留出集 nDCG@10 高 7.2%，成本约束下每查询 token 减少 11%。
papers.key_insight: 对社区 UGC 搜索，最值得借鉴的是把查询改写、召回和重排组件的改动与质量、成本指标共同记录，让搜索代理从可归因反馈中学习。可先在离线流水线中建立父子版本对照，再用独立留出集验证 nDCG，避免把多组件同时变更造成的相关性当作因果效果。

papers.title: DAGent: Evaluate-then-Grow Planning for Deep Research Agents
papers.authors: Hanwen Liu, Yuanfu Sun, Qiaoyu Tan
papers.abstract: Deep research tasks require agents to navigate large knowledge spaces, synthesize evidence across many sources, and adapt their plans as findings emerge. Directed acyclic graph (DAG)-based multi-agent systems suit this setting because they support parallel execution and isolate each sub-task within a focused dependency context. Yet existing DAG-based agents instantiate a task-level plan before execution and repair the graph only after failures or missing evidence are observed. This Plan-then-Patch strategy is brittle for deep research: the system commits most strongly when its evidence is weakest, and later revisions waste computation on branches that should not have been planned. We propose DAGent, a DAG-based multi-agent framework with Evaluate-then-Grow incremental planning: an Orchestrator grows the task graph one batch at a time, conditioning each expansion on confidence and uncertainty signals from completed nodes. A hierarchical context layer propagates compact QueryDocs by defa
papers.summary: DAGent 将深度研究规划从先建完整任务图再修补，改为依据已完成节点的置信度和不确定性逐批扩展；层次上下文默认传递紧凑 QueryDocs，并按需回看轨迹。Qwen3-235B-A22B 在 BrowseComp-Plus、GAIA、xbench-DeepSearch 上领先最强开源基线 5.3、5.8、2.0 点，8B 的 DAGRPO 比等预算 GRPO 高 3.0 点平均 Pass@1。
papers.key_insight: 社区复杂查询可先完成最有信息价值的证据节点，再决定是否扩展搜索，减少在证据不足时固定计划造成的无效分支。可借鉴紧凑上下文与完整轨迹分层存储，联合监控准确率、工具调用数和 token 成本；拓扑奖励的收益需与同结构、同预算基线比较，不能归因给模型规模。

papers.title: PatchHolmes: Agentic Patch Retrieval via Listwise Selection
papers.authors: Guanqun Yang, Yingming Zhou, Jiangrui Zheng, Shudong Hao, Xueqing Liu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.38807v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Patch retrieval, the task of finding the commit that fixes a known vulnerability, is the foundation of vulnerability management workflows, yet 60% to 63% of CVEs in the major advisory databases lack a patch link. We present PatchHolmes, a two-phase patch retrieval system that pairs a hybrid first-stage retriever with an agentic second-stage inspection loop. Unlike pointwise prior work that scores each candidate independently, the Phase 2 agent reads the top-100 listwise: it sees the full candidate list at once and selectively reads 3 to 10 commits through four budgeted tools before submitting a single best commit. On GitHubAD, PatchHolmes beats the pointwise binary classifier Favia by 25.34% Recall@1 and the retrieve-and-CoT baseline IRCoT by 31.40%, at one agent conversation per CVE versus Favia's ten; with the candidate set held identical, the agent adds 27.32% Recall@1 over taking the retriever's top candidate, and the same agent, tra
papers.summary: PatchHolmes 用混合检索获得候选，再让代理按列表整体比较 top-100，通过四类有预算工具选择性读取 3–10 个提交。GitHubAD 上 Recall@1 比 Favia 高 25.34%、比 IRCoT 高 31.40%；迁移至 PatchFinder_top10 后从 24.28% 提升到 39.86%，每个漏洞只需一次代理对话，模型无需微调。
papers.key_insight: 可把列表级比较与受预算约束的证据检查迁移到复杂 UGC 搜索：先廉价召回，再让代理只深入阅读少量有争议的候选。论文固定候选集合后仍有增益，支持第二阶段决策本身的价值；但漏洞提交与社区帖子不同，应另测 nDCG、CTR 及尾延迟，并限制工具调用预算。

papers.title: MemLife: Curating and Reasoning over Long-Term Egocentric Video Memories
papers.authors: Guangzhi Xiong, Xinyuan Zhang, Xiao Yang, Hyokun Yun, Kai Zhang
papers.abstract: Long-term egocentric video enables personalized AI assistants to reason about daily life. However, as video histories grow to hundreds of hours spanning months or years, reprocessing raw clips for every query becomes computationally prohibitive. Memory systems offer a scalable alternative by compacting videos into text representations, but often fail on practical benchmarks: either the memory does not preserve key evidence, or the retriever fails to locate relevant entries due to retrieval competition in growing search spaces. To address these challenges, we introduce MemLife, a multimodal memory system that constructs entity-grounded, first-person text episodes and retrieves them via a time-indexed agentic reader. Without training or query-time video access, MemLife improves over the strongest training-free baseline by 4.6--12.0% across four long-horizon benchmarks. To further improve memory quality, we propose MemOpt, a reinforcement learning framework that optimizes the memory write
papers.summary: MemLife 针对长期第一视角视频反复处理成本与记忆检索竞争，生成实体锚定的文本事件，再由时间索引代理读取。在四个长程基准上，无训练且查询时不访问视频的版本比最强免训练基线高 4.6%–12.0%；MemOpt 用强化学习优化记忆写入，再提升 2.7%–5.0%，并跨写入器、读取器及记忆系统泛化。
papers.key_insight: 对包含用户历史互动的社区搜索代理，可借鉴实体、事件和时间共同组织记忆，减少摘要丢失关键证据及长历史中检索竞争。先用免训练读取方案验证记忆检索是否改善复杂查询，再考虑强化学习优化写入；视频基准收益不能直接解释为短文本搜索提升，应核验原帖引用与隐私边界。

papers.title: False Frontiers: Diagnosing and Mitigating Co-Cheating in Self-Evolving Search Agents
papers.authors: Meijia Chen, Hao Li, Zheng Lu, Hongshan Lin, Junbai Tian
papers.abstract: Self-evolving search agents build their own training curricula by jointly optimizing a proposer that generates questions and a solver that answers them. This closed loop introduces a failure mode we call co-cheating: the proposer and solver increasingly agree on shared errors, so internal reward improves without a matching gain in external correctness. A post-hoc audit against source evidence shows co-cheating growing more severe over successive rounds of self-evolution, with pseudo-label correctness stagnating or declining even as the in-loop training signal improves. The most direct mitigation is to verify proposals before training: we introduce multi-sample verification (MSV), which queries the same model three times with the source and three times without it to decide task admission and replace unreliable pseudo-labels. MSV partially reduces false agreement but leaves substantial residual co-cheating and costs six extra labeler generations per candidate. These limitations motivate
papers.summary: 论文发现搜索代理自演化中出题者和解题者会共享错误，内部奖励增长并不代表外部正确率提高。CrossFit 将来源文档分组，用只在另一组训练的辅助解题者反馈；4B、9B 错误一致率从 6.1%、8.8% 降至 3.0%、3.7%，在七个搜索基准上比标准耦合自演化平均高 8.8、8.4 点。
papers.key_insight: UGC 搜索若采用模型生成查询和伪标签训练搜索代理，应隔离生成来源与反馈模型的数据血缘，并保留基于原文的独立审计集。简单多次采样验证每候选需六次额外生成，却只部分抑制共错；交叉拟合更值得试验，但还要核算辅助模型训练成本和真实用户查询上的泛化。

papers.title: Mid-Harness: Scaling Actions Between Model and Harness for Terminal Agents
papers.authors: Minki Kang, Ryo Hachiuma, Shaokun Zhang, Subhashree Radhakrishnan, Yonggan Fu
papers.abstract: Terminal agents act through stochastic model generations, yet the ability to generate a useful action does not ensure its reliable execution. A poor command (e.g., wrong package install) can change the environment in ways that hinder subsequent progress, even when the model could generate a better alternative. We investigate whether allocating test-time compute at the model-harness boundary can improve action reliability and trajectory success, and what makes this allocation effective. To study these questions, we introduce Mid-Harness, which samples and verifies candidate actions before forwarding one for execution, while keeping the generator and harness unchanged. With a TMAX-9B generator, more action sampling yields little benefit under weak verification, whereas a capable verifier can exploit useful alternatives from the same generator. On TerminalBench-Lite, a GPT-5.6 Sol verifier raises Pass@1 from 50.00% for the base agent to 68.03% with 8 sampled actions. When the same TMAX-9B
papers.summary: Mid-Harness 在模型生成和工具执行之间采样多个动作，再验证并选择一个执行，保持动作生成器与原 harness 不变。TMAX-9B 在 TerminalBench-Lite 上配合 GPT-5.6 Sol 验证器及八个候选动作，Pass@1 从 50.00% 升至 68.03%；弱验证器则难以利用更多采样，验证器蒸馏还能进一步改善结果。
papers.key_insight: 多步社区搜索可试验在关键检索或工具调用前比较若干候选动作，避免一个低质量查询使整条轨迹偏离。核心约束是验证器必须有辨别能力，单纯增加采样不保证成功；先在少数关键步骤做小预算实验，再比较每成功任务的 token、调用成本及延迟，不能直接沿用终端任务增益。

papers.title: Conformal Factuality Control for Multi-Hop Retrieval-Augmented Generation
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.38222v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) can ground large language models in external evidence, but retrieved context does not guarantee that generated claims are factually supported. This problem is especially relevant in multi-hop RAG, where retrieval and reasoning proceed through multiple dependent stages. We study whether claim-level conformal factuality control, previously developed for RAG, remains effective in this setting. We apply split-conformal claim filtering to multi-hop RAG and evaluate it on HotpotQA, Natural Questions, and TriviaQA using Llama 3.1 8B and GPT-4o-mini, together with a single-hop reference experiment. Across all six multi-hop model-dataset configurations, increasingly stringent conformal targets consistently increase the fraction of responses whose retained claims are fully supported. At the 95% target, this rate ranges from 95.80% to 97.20%, compared with 55.60%-76.03% without filtering. However, the improvemen
papers.summary: 研究把分割共形声明过滤用于多跳 RAG，在 HotpotQA、Natural Questions、TriviaQA 与两个模型形成的六种配置上检验事实性。95% 目标下，保留声明全部有支持的响应比例达到 95.80%–97.20%，未过滤为 55.60%–76.03%；但仅保留 4.41%–31.09% 声明，非空响应只占 9.70%–51.40%。
papers.key_insight: 社区答案搜索可以在多步检索之后增加声明级支持校验，优先控制无证据结论，而非仅凭找到相关帖子就输出完整答案。实验提醒可靠率必须与回答覆盖率一起呈现，否则大量弃答会制造质量改善的错觉；上线试验应同时观察支持率、非空率、用户满意度与点击转化。

papers.title: TRACE: Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction for LitTraceQA
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.38861v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: Finding a relevant paper is not the same as producing a verifiable answer from it. LitTraceQA requires canonical paper identifiers, exact evidence at the page or object level, and typed answers that match the evaluator. We call the separation between source access and scorer-visible correctness the grounding contract gap. TRACE - Target-Aware Retrieval, Attributed Evidence, and Contract-Constrained Extraction - addresses this gap with target-grouped retrieval, independent typed evidence localization, multimodal table extraction, schema-driven table construction, and fail-closed validation. It indexes 27,487 papers through passage, object, alias, citation, and dense representations while retaining the question target behind each signal. For tables, TRACE predicts the observation unit before extracting values and assembles rows with evaluator-compatible key normalization. Our audited selected clean-track artifact scores 0.760613 on the o
papers.summary: TRACE 面向可核验研究问答，将目标分组检索、类型化证据定位、视觉表格抽取与失败关闭校验结合，索引 27,487 篇论文。官方 71 题测试的总分为 0.760613，论文 F1 为 0.9728、证据 F1 为 0.6847、表格行 F1 为 0.5423、宏平均单元格准确率为 0.3508，显示定位到论文并不意味着正确提取答案。
papers.key_insight: 社区多步问答应把找到来源、定位原帖段落和生成可核验答案视为独立环节，保留对象标识与字段类型，并对证据缺失实行明确失败处理。论文中来源召回与表格数值准确率的落差提示：仅优化召回指标不足以衡量答案质量，需增加证据定位、字段一致性和最终回答评测。

papers.title: Learning to Route in Visual Space via Multi-Step Embedding Retrieval
papers.authors: Tianyu Chen, Mingyuan Zhou, Jiaxing Wu
papers.abstract:
arXiv:2609.38743v1 Announce Type: cross 
Abstract: LLM agents rely on retrieval tools to access external knowledge, yet visual agentic search remains severely bottlenecked by standard single-step retrievers. In current pipelines, the agent must issue text queries for every intermediate step, struggling when visual clues are difficult to describe or when the retriever fails to surface necessary intermediate evidence within its top results. We hypothesize that offloading multi-step navigation across the entire embedding space directly to the retrieval tool resolves this performance bottleneck. To study this systematically, we introduce VHOP, a flexible data generation framework and benchmark with five core difficulty levels testing both visual matching and search planning. Using this framework, we develop VHOP-Router, an end-to-end training pipeline---combining supervised fine-tuning, online imitation learning, and reinforcement learning---that transforms a standard embedding model into
papers.summary: VHOP-Router 将视觉空间多步导航下放给检索工具，结合监督微调、在线模仿和强化学习，一次调用返回关联图像链，无需代理逐步生成文本查询。VHOP 检索表现从不足 5% 到 76.3%；代理任务成功率报告提升 52.7%，平均 token 从 1886 降至 728，相比每步 top-50 检索，上下文图像减少 23 倍。
papers.key_insight: 对带图片的社区搜索，视觉线索难以转成文本时，可试验让检索器直接导航图像关系，再交给代理综合证据。论文比较升级代理与升级工具，提示多步系统的瓶颈可能在检索能力；迁移前需构造真实帖子图像链与未见难度测试，避免把合成 VHOP 的收益直接外推到普通文本 nDCG。

papers.title: Graph-centric agentic intelligence
papers.abstract: Augmenting a network graph with agentic AI produces a “digital twin” that can help isolate network failures.
papers.summary: AWS 将网络数字孪生图与代理编排结合，先按连通性分解，再做社区聚类，最后按告警条件计算中心性，将候选从数千节点缩至数百再到数十。文章报告与 NTT DOCOMO 在商业网络上把根因分析推进到分钟级；代理围绕候选扩展 2–3 跳证据，但未给出受控对照表或线上搜索指标。
papers.key_insight: 可借鉴先查历史事件知识库、再按问题复杂度调用确定性图算法的流程，帮助社区搜索代理在关系链查询中缩小证据空间。把图分析结果、时间线和原始引用交给代理综合，而非依赖语言模型凭空推断；网络故障定位经验可迁移，但需要单独验证帖子关系图质量及搜索延迟。
